corrections.earlier_claim: Generated database secrets never appear in logs
corrections.true_state: The first node printed 17 secret-bearing lines to its EC2 console; they were deleted and the node rebuilt before anything used them.
corrections.mechanism: The bootstrap script ran with shell tracing on.
corrections.caught_by: automated security review of the commit

corrections.earlier_claim: The cell's network is ready for k3s
corrections.true_state: The VPC used the same address range as k3s's pod network, so pods could not reach DNS; the cell was rebuilt in 10.44.0.0/16.
corrections.mechanism: VPC range chosen without checking k3s's defaults.
corrections.caught_by: Caddy could not get a certificate

not_checked.why_not: No alert channel is configured yet.

not_done.action: Alerts when a site goes down
not_done.reason: No destination chosen (email, Slack or similar).
The Diolog26 org disables Actions on the fork, and Egress's Linux runners are x64 while the node is arm64.
not_done.what_would_unblock: An org admin allowing Actions on Diolog26/uptime-kuma.
